description:
[Admin]

Builds one brand's stylesheet from its style settings and CSS files and puts it live at once. The build is tokens first, then the files by sort order and path, with every @import moved to the top and any "<" removed. Over 500 KB is a warning, over 2 MB is refused. Earlier builds stay in place. Style settings and CSS files are switched on per company by JobMojito; while they are off this endpoint answers 403. Write the drafts first with portal-configuration-update.

brand_id.description: The sub-brand to publish. Leave it out for the main brand, the company's own.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

files.description: Publish the drafts of only these CSS files; the others stay as they were last published. Leave it out to publish every draft of this brand.

merchant_id.description: Optional company. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's company.

portal.description: `interview` (career and interview portal) or `consumer` (coaching portal). Only the interview portal has brands.

name: Publish_a_brand_stylesheet

hash.description: First 16 characters of the SHA-256 of the stylesheet.

url.description: Address of the built stylesheet. It is named after its content and never changes.

warnings.description: Worth telling the person, none of them stopped the publish: over 500 KB, rules outside .jm-site that reach the rest of the portal, removed "<" characters.

title: Portal Css Publish
